propositions: git commit --amend -F drops the Change-Id trailer, causing Gerrit to stamp a new one and create a duplicate change instead of a new patchset
prepare-commit-msg hook cannot distinguish amending with -F from a fresh -F commit, so it cannot preserve Change-Id during amend
A make amend-msg wrapper must read HEAD's Change-Id, strip any Change-Id line from the supplied message file, and re-apply the original Change-Id via git interpret-trailers before amending
make amend-msg must fail loudly and non-zero when HEAD carries no Change-Id, rather than allowing the commit-msg hook to stamp a fresh one
AGENTS.md documentation must name make amend-msg as the recommended path for rewritten commit messages and explicitly warn that --amend -m/-F drop Change-Id and create duplicate changes
